meta.dataset: ESA WorldCover (land cover; only 'Cropland', not crop type)
meta.credit: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (CC BY 4.0); hosted by Microsoft Planetary Computer
notes: This dataset only separates cropland from other land; it cannot say which crop is grown. No open crop-type map was found for this region.
Polygons are connected groups of same-class pixels from a satellite classification, not surveyed field boundaries; the dataset has no field IDs.
